mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 0.1% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 225 signals accelerating inflation that triggers Fed rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days due to reduced real equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 225, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise signals stagflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as the market discounts growth-inflation risks.
failure_condition: The joint signal produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the interaction's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0), a PAYEMS decline signals deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days due to recessionary expectations.
failure_condition: In UNRATE > 8.0 regimes, 60-day SPX returns are positive in > 60% of PAYEMS decline instances, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising HOUST consistently signals expanding consumer demand and construction activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as growth expectations strengthen.
failure_condition: HOUST rises but 20-day SPX returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO falling below 90 indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days due to reduced corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 90 but 60-day SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST rising with INDPRO falling indicates demand-supply mismatch, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as market prices in supply chain disruption risks.
failure_condition: The joint signal yields positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the interaction's Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, FEDFUNDS rising above 0.1% triggers negative S&P 500 returns within 5 days as higher borrowing costs reduce liquidity and equity valuations.
failure_condition: In tightening cycles, 5-day SPX returns are positive in > 60% of FEDFUNDS > 0.1% instances, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03.
